name: Basel
notes: Stadt Basel levies NO separate municipal tax; residents pay the full 100% cantonal tariff (incomeTaxBrackets/wealthTaxBrackets result) with no municipal surcharge/discount layer at all.

name: Bettingen
notes: Kanton collects a fixed 50% Kantonssteuerquote of the bracket-table tax directly; Bettingen sets its own Gemeindesteuerquote (max 50%) separately for income (37.50%) and wealth (36.50%) tax. Total effective multiplier = 50+37.5=87.5% (income) / 50+36.5=86.5% (wealth) of the bracket-table amount. Generic 'municipalMultiplier' left null because BS needs two separate income/wealth figures -- see municipalMultiplierIncomePercent/WealthPercent.
